A merge-ordering policy (T3) therefore cannot keep Track C's CI green after landing. The C8 pin lives in a user-approval record whose blob 20e36409 is pinned in source.

candidates.description:
Track C Frozen Projection Identity Audit (FPIA), from the T2 'frozen projection' family. It is a new, additive integration audit that leaves the frozen tools, records and meaning untouched.

For an integrated or advanced tree T it does six things:
(1) Replays the unmodified frozen tools at the exact Frozen evidence heads named in the records, and requires deep equality with the recorded evidence.
(2) Replays the unmodified tools at the Track C reference R, passed as a parameter (e.g. b9e01a9).
(3) Builds a sandbox-only projection commit Π. Π has exactly R's path set with T's blobs and parent T. The UNMODIFIED tools then run on Π under the recorded canonical premise (K read from R's tool), and Π's evidence must equal R's apart from tested_head, merge_base, ahead and behind.
(4) Requires byte identity of R's whole Track C footprint in T. This closes a gap the frozen predicates leave open: a later Track C report can be tampered without any frozen predicate firing.
(5) Certifies the complement T\paths(R):
- every Track C-namespace or EVL-importing file is byte-identical to a declared verified v2 reference V (e.g. #31 c9e0fa7);
- no conftest, sitecustomize or .pth file, and no pytest config at rootdir-relevant locations;
- no import shadowing;
- the fixture computations on T equal Π's once the whole-package code-identity hash is pinned in memory.
(6) Runs targeted and full regression on T, and records the frozen tools' verbatim FAIL on T (MAC-X1) without converting it.

The verdict carries its own label (TRACK_C_FROZEN_IDENTITY_PRESERVED_INTEGRATION_EVIDENCE), is bound to the exact T SHA, and is never called C6/C7/C8 acceptance.

Feasibility measured in this task with the unmodified tools:
- 166dcba: the C6 record's evidence object deep-equals the replay (0 diffs, a9ca68be).
- c5932f9: the C7 record's current_resolved_acceptance deep-equals the replay (0 diffs, 516ca461 / code f479ce9e).
- ff78c4f: C8p rc=0, APPROVED_FOUNDATION_PROTOCOL_PASS.
- b9e01a9: all rc=0 (C6 8678506b, C7 508dc058 / 2ed79c3c, C8 code 0ef3a900).
- Π of #40 acaf1b5 onto b9e01a9 is commit 922a7eb, tree 66b9a8a7. Only the workflow and the decision register differ from R. All three tools rc=0, and the evidence equals R's apart from the 4 descriptive keys.
- #40 complement: 474 files. AV is 18 (7 namespace + 11 EVL-importing), all byte-identical to c9e0fa7, 0 unattributed, 0 hook files, 0 shadowing.
- #40 computations: raw C6 23e960ff / C7 399a86a3 / C8 payload d787336e, all PASS. With the code hash pinned they equal Π exactly (C6 8678506b; C7 and C8 results deep-equal).
- #40 already contains #21, #13, #16, #5, #6, #7 and #9, so it is the broad positive case.
- Negative controls on Π: a tampered evl/walkforward.py fails C6.b/C7.1/C8.1; IF-1 technical/engine.py drift fails C6.e/C7.1/C8.1; a non-append edit of CURRENT_HANDOFF fails C8.3. Each Frozen invariant, how it is certified on a moving base, and by which deterministic check:

  - Whole-tree form: impossible on any integrated tree. The tools' result on T is recorded verbatim as FAIL (V0) and never converted.
  - For integration evidence only, it is replaced by four checks. N1: every complement file that is in R-tool-derived Track C namespace or EVL-importing, closed under imports, must be byte-identical to a declared V. N2: no startup or pytest hooks. N3: no import shadowing. E2: equivalence modulo code identity.
  - The frozen check itself is not weakened. Treating N1–N3/E2 as equivalent is D3-1.
- **I3, canonical blobs outside Track C unchanged** (C6.c vs K b8e39a2, C7.2/C8.2 vs anchors). The unmodified predicates run on Π (P2). Any modification of a pre-existing K path by any capability FAILs, as strict as now.
- **I4, the four C4 repairs/IF-1 trio and lineage.py** (C6.e, C6.f). P2, unmodified.
- **I9, append-only overlays and HANDOFF_HISTORY unchanged since BASE** (C8.3, C8.2). P2 unmodified, plus I1 requiring a prefix of R's bytes, which is stronger than prefix of BASE.
- **I10, live canonical pin** (C6.a; C8.6 via approval record 20e36409 pinned in calibration_contracts).
  - Not altered. V0 runs the tools against the live canonical and records the FAIL verbatim.
  - The premise is re-evaluated only inside a throwaway sandbox at R and Π, with K read from R's tool. The tool itself checks K against the approval record's canonical_head.
  - A1 requires K to be an ancestor of T. The certificate is bound to the exact T SHA, so every canonical move requires a new run: this is the 'fresh integration audit' the failure message asks for. A5 records the live canonical relation.
- **I5, acceptance hashes.**
  - H1 reproduces the recorded evidence at the exact evidence trees (deep equality).
  - H2 reproduces R's owner-accepted values (8678506b etc., the S0 values of Actions 37097149378).

Whole-tree: under N1, only R and verified-V code can reference EVL; N2/N3 also apply. The audit reads no Holdout or CAL_VERIFY: synthetic fixtures only.
- **I11, Actions run ids bound to tested heads.** Untouched and never relabelled.
- **I12, scope and non-grant labels.** Covered by P3 and E1.
- **Frozen tooling identity.** F1: T's tool blobs equal R's. F2: tool lineage is monotonic against every evidence-head version.

design.implementation_spec:
MAC-X1 Track C Frozen Projection Identity Audit (FPIA) v1. Build on a new PIW branch; never merge it.

## 0. Ownership and write set
- Branch integration/mac-x1-frozen-identity-audit-v1, created from freshly fetched canonical b8e39a2 and owned by the PIW.
- Push, Draft PR and dispatch are §C-autonomous only if the orchestrating PIW enables remote writes.
- New files only:
  - (1) implementation/tools/integration/track_c_frozen_identity_audit.py: the CLI. Stdlib only. No static import of investment_system, tests.* or tools.track_c_*.
  - (2) implementation/tools/integration/track_c_frozen_identity_compute.py: the computation harness. It is copied into a fresh temp dir and run as a subprocess inside a sandbox worktree. It takes module names at runtime and has no static EVL import.
  - (3) implementation/tools/integration/track_c_frozen_identity_negative_controls.py: the real-history control matrix. It is not pytest-collected.
  - (4) implementation/tests/test_integration_track_c_frozen_identity_audit.py: synthetic-repo unit tests. They are safe on shallow checkouts.
  - (5) .github/workflows/integration-track-c-frozen-identity.yml: workflow_dispatch only.
- Never edit:
  - implementation/tools/track_c_*, any implementation/reports/track_c_*, or .github/workflows/track-c-evl-validation.yml;
  - the Track C decision register;
  - any evl/, tests/evl_* or tests/test_evl_* path, or any CDR-009/011 path;
  - #4, ccr-22e3ff16, codex/*, #21, RIG or any other owner branch;
  - PR #40 or its evidence.
- Results are recorded by the PIW as additive GIE-012 evidence on integration/global-handoff-v1.

## 1. CLI
```
python3 implementation/tools/integration/track_c_frozen_identity_audit.py \
  --repo PATH --target REV --track-c-ref REV [--v2-ref REV ...] \
  [--live-canonical REV] [--python PATH] [--regression none|targeted|full] \
  [--deselect NODEID ...] [--work-dir DIR] [--keep-sandbox] [--no-cache] \
  --out FILE.json
```
- --repo must contain all objects.
- --target is the integrated tree T.
- --track-c-ref is R, the Track C head being integrated, e.g. b9e01a9.
- --v2-ref is V, repeatable: the verified v2 head(s), e.g. #31 c9e0fa7.
- --live-canonical defaults to refs/remotes/origin/<BRANCH>, with BRANCH read from R's c6 tool.
- --python is an interpreter with pytest==9.1.1 and numpy==2.3.5, Python 3.11.
- --deselect values are recorded in the output. Locally, pass tests/test_raw_and_providers.py::test_live_sec_fetch_is_optional_and_not_stage2.
- Exit 0 only if the overall verdict is PASS, 1 on FAIL, 2 on NOT_RUN or internal error.
- Evidence runs use --no-cache. A cache keyed by (R, tool blobs, record blobs, python version) is allowed only for the control matrix, and every cache hit is recorded.

## 2. Inputs derived from the tree, never as literals
From R's three tool blobs, by AST (Assign/Constant nodes):
- From c6 (implementation/tools/track_c_c6_acceptance.py): K=CANONICAL, BRANCH, S6=START, ALLOWED6 (the `allowed` set inside boundary_audit).
- From c7: S7=START and ALLOWED7=allowed_existing.
- From c8p: B8=BASE, OVERLAYS, INFRA.
- Namespace NS:
  - NS prefixes are the str arguments of every .startswith() call inside the c6 `frozen`/`unexpected_new` expressions, the c7 `unexpected_new` expression and the c8 `unauthorized` expression. At b9e01a9 that gives evl/, tests/test_evl_c, tests/evl_c6, tests/test_evl_c6, reports/track_c_ and tools/track_c_.
  - NS literals are the 'implementation/…' str constants inside those admitted-new expressions and in c7 NEW_FILES and c8 NEW_SOURCE_TESTS/GSUP_FILES/RUNNER: 21 at b9e01a9. The modification allowlists are excluded on purpose.
  - NS(p) is true when p starts with a prefix or is a literal.
- Fixture and digest module names come from the tools' ImportFrom nodes (tests.evl_c6_fixture, tests.evl_c7_fixture, tests.evl_c8_fixture, investment_system.evl.walkforward, investment_system.evl.profile_selection).
- Output paths come from the main-block Path literal and the '/' operand.

From the Frozen records in R's tree, through a fixed 3-entry schema binding that only makes checks stricter:
- C6: reports/track_c_c6_acceptance_2026-10-01.json. Head field `tested_head`. Tools: c6. Prefix TRACK_C_C6_EVIDENCE=. Compare record.evidence for deep equality.
- C7: reports/track_c_c7_acceptance_2026-10-01.json. Head field `code_validated_head`. Tools: c7. Prefix TRACK_C_C7_EVIDENCE=. Compare record.current_resolved_acceptance for deep equality, plus software_acceptance_report_hash against integrated.acceptance.report_hash and code_hash against integrated.code_hash.
- C8p: reports/track_c_c8_partial_foundation_verification_2026-10-02.json. Head field `validated_head`. Tools: c6, c7 and c8p. Checks:
  - record.acceptance.{C6,C7} == 'PASS' and every rc is 0;
  - replay status == record.acceptance.C8_partial;
  - record.approval_blob == replay approval_blob == the git blob id of reports/track_c_c8_partial_approval_2026-10-02.json at the head;
  - C8_SOFTWARE_FROZEN is False in both.

Code-identity sites are discovered by AST in the .py files of FP(R). A site is a module-level Assign to a Name, or a FunctionDef, whose subtree calls .rglob() with a str argument ending in '.py'. At R these are tests/evl_c6_fixture.py:CODE and evl/calibration_contracts.py:code_hash.

## 3. Sandbox (deterministic; all writes disclosed)
- Create a private clone with `git clone --no-checkout --shared <repo> <work>/sbx`. If objects/info/alternates is missing, write it to point at <repo>/.git/objects and record that.
- Create one detached worktree per run, registered only in sbx. Run the tools exactly like the workflow: cwd = <wt>/implementation, `PYTHONPATH=src:. <python> tools/<tool>.py`, env limited to PATH, HOME=tmp, LANG=C.UTF-8 and PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1. Run in the order c6, c7, c8p, then remove the worktree.
- Ref writes are allowed only for refs/remotes/origin/<BRANCH> in sbx: K for the H, P and V-integrity replays, and live L for V0. Each write is logged as {ref, old, new, purpose}.
- Synthetic commits are built with plumbing only, using fixed author/committer 'track-c-frozen-identity-audit' and date 2000-01-01T00:00:00Z.
  - Π = commit-tree(tree{p ↦ (mode, blob) of T for p ∈ paths(R)}, parent T), message 'FROZEN_PROJECTION <T> onto paths(<R>) [sandbox only]'.
  - Its SHA is a deterministic function of (T, R).
- The sandbox is deleted unless --keep-sandbox is given.
- Nothing is pushed, and --repo is never written.

## 4. Checks
Notation: X[p] is the (mode, blob) of p in X; FP(R) = {p ∈ R : p ∉ K or R[p] ≠ K[p]} ∪ {p ∈ R : NS(p)}.

**A: ancestry and Frozen history**
- A1: K is an ancestor of T.
- A2: R is an ancestor of T. Squash or rebase landings FAIL.
- A3: every record head is an ancestor of R.
- A4: for each V, R is an ancestor of V and V is an ancestor of T.
- A5 (descriptive): L, is-ancestor(L,T), is-ancestor(T,L) and ahead/behind. A5 has no pass condition.

**F: frozen tooling**
- F1: for each of the 3 tool paths, T[p] == R[p] in blob and mode.
- F2: tool lineage. For each record head E and each tool present at E:
  - (a) every module-level 40-hex str constant and BRANCH is equal between E and R;
  - (b) the modification allowlists are equal as sets (ALLOWED6, ALLOWED7, OVERLAYS, INFRA);
  - (c) the admitted-new literal and prefix set at E is a subset of the set at R;
  - (d) every element of R-set \ E-set is in NS and, if it is a path, exists in R.

**H: exact-tree replay (unmodified tools)**
- H1: for each record, run its tools at its head, using the tool blobs at that head, with sbx ref = the head tool's CANONICAL. Comparisons follow §2 and are exact.
- H2: c6, c7 and c8p at R with ref = K must all have rc 0. Capture E_R from the stdout JSON.

**P: frozen projection**
- P1: paths(R) ⊆ paths(T).
- P2: c6, c7 and c8p at Π with ref = K must all have rc 0.
- P3: strip(E_Π) == strip(E_R), where strip removes the keys {tested_head, merge_base, ahead, behind} at every depth.

**I: footprint identity**
- I1: for every p ∈ FP(R), at least one of the following holds; otherwise FAIL listing p:
  - T[p] == R[p];
  - p ∈ OVERLAYS and bytes(T[p]) starts with bytes(R[p]);
  - p ∈ INFRA, p is not one of the tool paths, and T[p] == V[p] for some V.
- Also run with T := each V (V-integrity).

**N: complement non-interference**
Let C = paths(T) \ paths(R). TCMOD is the set of dotted names, over the roots implementation/src, implementation and implementation/tools, of the .py files p ∈ R with NS(p), plus 'investment_system.evl'.

EVLREF(p) is true when an AST Import or ImportFrom in p hits TCMOD by equality or prefix+'.'. Relative imports are resolved against p's package under each root, and `from A import b` is tested as A and A.b. It is also true for importlib.import_module, __import__, runpy.run_module/run_path or importlib.util.spec_from_file_location called with a str-constant first argument that resolves into TCMOD or FP(R). A parse error counts as true.

AV = closure under imports of {p ∈ C : NS(p) or EVLREF(p)}: add every C module that an AV .py file imports. Measured at #40 before the closure step: 18.

- N1: every p ∈ AV has some V with p ∈ V and T[p] == V[p]. Otherwise FAIL 'unattributed Track C-scope file'.
- N2: no p ∈ C has basename conftest.py, sitecustomize.py or usercustomize.py, or suffix .pth. No p ∈ C is named pytest.ini, tox.ini, setup.cfg, pyproject.toml or setup.py inside '', 'implementation/' or 'implementation/tests/'.
- N3: for every root, every .py, .so or .pyd p ∈ C must satisfy:
  - dotted(p) ∉ Dotted(R), the set of every R module under every root;
  - if dotted(p) has no dot, it is not in sys.stdlib_module_names ∪ importlib.metadata.packages_distributions() of --python.
- N4 (INFO only): non-constant dynamic-import call sites in C.

**E: computations on T (code-identity channel)**
- E0: every discovered code-identity site is an Assign to a Name or a FunctionDef. Otherwise E is NOT_RUN.
- E1 (raw): run the harness in a T worktree: cwd implementation, sys.path = [src, .], output dirs mirrored from the tools, generated dirs removed before and after. Requirements:
  - C6 result.status == 'PASS';
  - C7 result.acceptance.status == 'PASS', and every STAGES name is present in the selection-report stages;
  - C8 status == 'APPROVED_FOUNDATION_PROTOCOL_PASS', C8_SOFTWARE_FROZEN is False, and artifact.{software_freeze_eligible, real_pit_research_validated, official, real_holdout_eligible} are False while {research_state, promotion_authority} are None.
  - The raw digests are recorded as INTEGRATED_TREE_RAW, never as Frozen values.
- E2 (pinned): patch the site modules first, setting CODE to E_Π.integrated.code_hash and code_hash to return E_Π.implementation.artifact.code_hash. Then import the fixtures, and assert that no loaded module still holds the original function. Requirements:
  - digest(C6 result) == E_Π.acceptance_hash;
  - the JSON-normalized C7 result == E_Π.integrated;
  - the JSON-normalized C8 result == E_Π.implementation.

**R: regression on T**
- R1: the targeted pytest steps parsed from R's track-c-evl-validation.yml: tests/test_evl_c8*.py, c7*, c6* and c[0-5]*.
- R2: the AV test files.
- R3: the full suite with the --deselect values.
- Each needs failed = 0, errors = 0 and collected > 0. Counts come from junit-xml.

**V0: verbatim frozen result on T**
- Run c6, c7 and c8p at T with ref = L and record rc plus the first error string.
- The status is FAIL whenever rc ≠ 0, and the output also notes 'expected_by_design: MAC-X1'.
- V0 is never part of any PASS and is never converted.

## 5. Output JSON
Schema: TRACK_C_FROZEN_IDENTITY_AUDIT/1.
- inputs: T, R, V and L SHAs; tool blobs; record blobs; python version, pytest and numpy versions.
- derived: K, anchors, the NS prefixes and literals, the code-identity sites.
- sandbox: clone path, ref_writes[], synthetic_commits[] (including Π).
- checks[]: id, invariant, predicate text, PASS / FAIL / NOT_RUN, details. Details hold failing paths, hashes, and the full AV attribution list with blob ids and V.
- frozen_tools_on_target_verbatim: V0.
- verdicts:
  - identity is PASS only if A1–A4, F1, F2, H1, H2, P1–P3, I1 (including V-integrity), N1–N3 and E0–E2 all PASS. Any FAIL makes it FAIL; otherwise it is NOT_RUN.
  - regression comes from R1–R3.
  - overall is TRACK_C_FROZEN_IDENTITY_PRESERVED_INTEGRATION_EVIDENCE when identity and regression both PASS, otherwise FAIL or NOT_RUN.
- non_claims (constant):
  - not C6/C7/C8 acceptance on T, not a Track C validation PASS, not C8 Freeze;
  - not canonical-merge approval;
  - the Frozen hashes a9ca68be and 516ca461 are not claimed for T;
  - v2 correctness is delegated to V's verification record (GIE-011 for c9e0fa7);
  - the frozen tools' verdict on T is V0.

## 6. Unit tests (file 4)
Each test builds a synthetic git repo in tmp_path. The repo has miniature tool doubles with the same AST shape (CANONICAL, START, BRANCH, allowed, unexpected_new, NEW_FILES, BASE, OVERLAYS, INFRA, GSUP_FILES, RUNNER, stdout prefixes), trivial fixtures that include a CODE rglob site and a code_hash site, and fake records.

Negative controls, each asserting FAIL with the named check id:
- NC1: tamper an anchored Frozen evl file. Expect P2 and I1.
- NC2: another capability edits a post-anchor Track C report. The frozen predicates pass; expect I1.
- NC3: non-append edit of an OVERLAY. Expect P2 via C8.3, and I1.
- NC4: IF-1 trio drift (technical/engine.py). Expect P2 via C6.e/C7.1/C8.1.
- NC5a: the record's Frozen hash differs from the replay. Expect H1.
- NC5b: a post-anchor R src file changes in T, so Π's CODE changes. Expect P3, and I1.
- NC6: extra new Track C-scope file not in R or V (evl/new.py, tests/test_evl_c9_x.py, reports/track_c_x.json). Expect N1.
- NC7: a foreign file imports investment_system.evl, statically or by a constant importlib call. Expect N1.
- NC8: conftest.py, sitecustomize.py or a .pth file added. Expect N2.
- NC9: shadowing via implementation/src/tests/__init__.py or implementation/tools/json.py. Expect N3.
- NC10: a frozen tool is edited in T, even only by adding to an allowlist. Expect F1.
- NC11: a squashed landing with an identical tree. Expect A2.
- NC12: R's tool is weakened by changing CANONICAL or extending ALLOWED6. Expect F2.
- NC13: a V-attributed file differs from V. Expect N1.
- NC14: the INFRA workflow changes without a matching V. Expect I1.
- NC15: V0 stays FAIL and the JSON never shows the frozen result on T as PASS.
- NC16: a code-identity site of an unpinnable kind. Expect E NOT_RUN, so the verdict is not PASS.

Positive controls, each asserting identity PASS:
- PC1: canonical advanced with docs-only additions (L ≠ K, V0 FAIL).
- PC2: a new code subpackage src/investment_system/newcap/ plus tests and a workflow. Raw E1 hashes differ and E2 is equal.
- PC3: Track C landed alone (T = merge of R into K, L = T).
- PC4: another capability appends to an OVERLAY.
- PC5: V-attributed v2 files plus a V workflow pin. Without --v2-ref this same tree FAILs N1.

## 7. Real-history controls and verification (file 3, plus a local run)
Expected results:
- (a) T = R = b9e01a9: identity PASS.
- (b) T = #40 acaf1b5, R = b9e01a9, V = c9e0fa7: identity PASS with V0 FAIL (C6.d/C7.3/C8.4 lists). Components already measured: Π 922a7eb, tree 66b9a8a7; AV 18, unattributed 0; E2 equal.
- (c) A sandbox canonical advance: L := a synthetic K + #21 merge, T := merge(L, b9e01a9). Identity PASS, V0 FAIL with 'canonical advanced'.
- (d) NC1–NC4 applied on top of the #40 projection. Expect FAIL with the measured messages: C6.b, C6.e and C8.3. NC2 is caught only by I1.
- (e) Optionally T = #39 0d31e06 with V = e0b6d80.

Then run the full regression of the audit branch itself.

Run independent or adversarial review only if a predicate's semantics is disputed; deterministic checks come first.

## 8. Workflow (file 5)
- Trigger: workflow_dispatch only, with inputs target, track_c_ref, v2_refs and regression (default full).
- permissions: contents: read.
- Steps:
  - actions/checkout@v4 with fetch-depth 0;
  - `git fetch --no-tags origin '+refs/heads/*:refs/remotes/origin/*' '+refs/pull/*/head:refs/remotes/pr/*'`;
  - setup-python 3.11;
  - pip install pytest==9.1.1 numpy==2.3.5;
  - the unit tests;
  - the audit with --repo $GITHUB_WORKSPACE;
  - upload-artifact for the JSON verdict and logs.
- No push or pull_request trigger. It never runs the Track C workflow and never writes refs remotely.

## 9. Still a user decision after implementation
- D3-1: whether the user adopts the FPIA verdict as Track C's 'separate Integration Audit' pass rule and the canonical-merge gate, and with it a 'Frozen identity preserved on integrated canonical' status.
- D3-2: whether v2 certification by identity to the verified head, plus R2, is enough.
- D3-3: the policy for future modifications of pre-existing canonical files or HANDOFF_HISTORY by other capabilities. Today these FAIL closed.
- D3-4: Track C branch CI going red after any advance.
- Every canonical merge itself, including merge-commit vs squash, is a §D12 decision.
design.d3_options_if_any:
These D3 items remain for the user. They are not implemented; each lists options with a recommendation.

**D3-1: Adopt the FPIA verdict as Track C's 'separate Integration Audit' pass rule and canonical-merge gate?**
Adopting it is a new Frozen acceptance meaning on an integrated or advanced tree: closed-world confinement is replaced by attribution plus non-interference, and the live pin is replaced by anchored replay plus exact-SHA binding. §D5, §D12, §D15, §N and CDR-013 apply.
- (a) Adopt it. The pass rule is identity PASS + regression PASS + a fresh dispatch run on the exact merge-result SHA. Record it additively as a new CDR plus a Track C scoped register entry, without changing any Frozen record. This mirrors the Track A FROZEN_VERIFIED precedent.
- (b) Use it as evidence only, and decide each merge case by case.
- (c) Require the owner-issued successor tools (candidate D) first.
- (d) Do not adopt it.
- Recommendation: (a).

**D3-2: Is identity to a verified v2 head enough to certify Codex v2 files on canonical?**

## Recommendation: candidate A, classified D1_D2
I recommend candidate A, the Track C Frozen Projection Identity Audit (FPIA). Building it is D1/D2 under CDR-013, §C, §M, §K and §B, so it can be implemented and verified now. It is additive and evidence-only:
- The frozen tools a60c4c5f, 6b9362d0 and e587a8d5, the Frozen records, the C8 approval record pin and PR #40 stay untouched and are never relabelled.

- The tools' MAC-X1 FAIL on T is recorded verbatim (V0) and never converted.

How it certifies a moving-base tree T:
1. It replays the unmodified tools at the exact Frozen evidence heads and requires deep equality with the records.
2. It replays them at R.
3. It runs them unmodified on a sandbox projection Π (R's paths with T's blobs, parent T), under the recorded premise K=b8e39a2 read from the tool. Π's evidence must equal R's except for tested_head, merge_base, ahead and behind.

## Verdict: refuted

The design holds up on the narrower points. It contains no hard-coded SHA, PR or path allowlist beyond values read from the frozen tools and records. It never edits the frozen tools or any owner branch, and it never relabels #40. Building FPIA as additive evidence is D1/D2, so I agree with that classification, and the fixes I list are all stricter checks that are also D1/D2. I re-derived Π(#40) independently and got the same tree, 66b9a8a7, that the design reports.

It does not hold up as a general method. I found three wrongful passes and one hidden ordering assumption, all demonstrated with deterministic sandbox commits, plus two generality gaps argued from the spec:
1. **Bytecode shadowing (T1 cca08a0).** A committed unchecked-hash `contracts/__pycache__/lineage.cpython-311.pyc` replaces the executed `lineage.py` code. N1, N2 and N3 do not flag it, and Π, CODE (d0c02ac2) and code_hash (df34b84f) all stay identical to #40's.
2. **Track C decision register (T4 16f9e1c).** A foreign, unattributed append to the register passes:
   - all three unmodified tools return rc=0 on Π(T4) 7cd302a;
   - their evidence matches R's apart from the four descriptive keys (C6 acceptance hash 8678506b in both);
   - the I1 overlay prefix rule accepts the change.
3. **Pytest plugin (T2 34ee139).** A committed `*.dist-info` pytest11 entry-point plugin turns a deliberately failing test into a pass (85 passed, junit failures=0). The same test shows '1 failed' with autoload disabled. This defeats the "failed = 0" requirement of R1/R3.
4. **Ordering (X ce83b48).** The overlay prefix rules make the result depend on merge order. If any capability appends to a shared overlay before Track C lands, no merge resolution passes C8.3/I1 while also keeping canonical's own append-only history. That amounts to an unstated D3 merge-ordering policy. It is not hit today: all ten non-Track C PR heads are add-only against b8e39a2.

Two further gaps are argued from the spec rather than demonstrated:
- The fixed set of three tools and three records would silently under-certify a future Track C phase instead of returning NOT_RUN.
